editorial:
Imagine being the kid everyone picks on in high school, just wanting a way to fight back. That is exactly where you find yourself with Hoax, a lonely teen who discovers a weird phone line called 976-EVIL. Instead of normal horoscopes, this service gives you horrorscopes that actually come true. Once Hoax gets a hold of these demonic powers, he stops being the victim and starts turning the tables on his bullies in some really wild ways. The whole movie has that classic 80s cheese factor, making it feel like a dark comic book brought to life with plenty of strange characters and creepy vibes.

You will probably love how the special effects look for the time, though some parts might feel a bit slow. The acting is over-the-top, but that is part of the fun. It is a great pick if you like movies where the underdog gets a bit too much power.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Hoax realizes the demonic power he used came with a heavy price. In the final scenes, the evil force behind the phone line comes to collect his soul. You see that the power was just a trap to lure him in. He tries to fight back, but the demon wins in the end. He ends up trapped in a hellish place, proving that shortcuts to revenge always end badly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s horror and revenge stories.
